key_insight: IDEAgent reframes research ideation as a joint quality-diversity search problem, using multi-agent lineage tracking to generate ideas that are both strong and meaningfully different.
engineering_relevance: The framework suggests a practical design pattern for AI research assistants: combine iterative repair/refinement with explicit memory-based diversity control to reduce repetitive or trivial outputs.
method: Multi-agent idea evolution organized as lineages
Quality improved via multi-objective feedback, repair, and refinement
Diversity enforced with sequential memory and comparison against prior, ancestor, and rejected ideas
evidence_signal: Across 32 topics in 8 Computer Science domains, IDEAgent achieved 3.89× higher Yield than the best baseline and produced non-zero Yield on 8× more topics.
watch_item: The approach may depend on careful thresholding, memory management, and reliable quality judgments, which could be difficult to calibrate across domains.
paper_title: IDEAgent: Agentic Quality-Diversity Search for Research Idea Generation
